units.source_text: 源氏公子独自寻思：“怎么办呢？

en.t: Prince Genji thought to himself, "What should I do?

units.source_text: 外人得知了，自然会批评我轻薄吧。

en.t: If others find out, they will naturally criticize me as frivolous.

units.source_text: 如果对方年龄相当，已经懂得男女之情，那么外人会推想那女的和我同心，

en.t: If she were of a suitable age and already understood the love between men and women, people would suppose that the girl shared my feelings,

units.source_text: 这就变成世间常有之事，不足怪了。

en.t: and then it would become something common in the world, nothing strange at all.

units.source_text: 可是现在并不如此，怎么办呢？

en.t: But that is not the case now, so what should I do?

units.source_text: 况且如被她父亲寻着了，很不好意思，有什么道理可说呢？”

en.t: Besides, if her father finds us, it will be terribly embarrassing; what possible excuse could I give?"
His mind was in utter confusion.

units.source_text: 但念错过这机会，后悔莫及，便决心在天未亮之前出发。

en.t: But thinking that he would regret it forever if he missed this chance, he resolved to set out before daybreak.

units.source_text: 葵姬照例沉默寡言，没有一句知心话。

en.t: Lady Aoi was silent and reserved as usual, without a single intimate word for him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便对她说：“我想起二条院那边有一件紧要的事，今天非办好不可。

en.t: Prince Genji then said to her, "I have remembered an urgent matter at the Nijo residence that must be settled today.
I will go there briefly and come back at once."

units.source_text: 便走了出来，连侍女们都没有发觉。

en.t: Then he went out, and not even the waiting women noticed.

units.source_text: 他走到自己房间里，换上那套便服，

en.t: He went to his own room and changed into that informal outfit,

units.source_text: 但叫惟光一人骑马跟随，向六条出发了。

en.t: then had only Koremitsu follow him on horseback and set out for Rokujo.
